Meetup in New York

Automation in Mobile Testing

  • Home
28 February 2019

One of the first series of N26 meetups in New York, actually the very 2nd one, where I talked about Mobile test architecture . My talk was mainly about:

  • Automation principles
  • How to scope your automation for mobile apps
  • How to design the architecture
  • How to decide and choose tools
  • How to maintain continuous testing for mobile
